# Flowen

> Flowen is an evidence-based AI speech fluency platform for people who stutter. Real-time vocal coordination training, clinical supervision tools, and 3D visual biofeedback — accessible via web browser.

## What Flowen does

Flowen helps people who stutter develop fluent speech through evidence-based techniques including diaphragmatic breathing, easy onset, prolonged speech, light articulatory contacts, and pull-out techniques. Sessions are guided by an AI that tracks real-time acoustic features including fundamental frequency, RMS amplitude, and formant structure.

## Who it is for

- Adults and children who stutter (ages 12+)
- Speech-language pathologists (SLPs) managing caseloads
- NHS and public-funded speech therapy services
- Organisations requiring workplace fluency support

## Key capabilities

- Sub-80ms real-time vocal analysis using Web Audio API
- 3D avatar with 42-state ARKit-style viseme blend shapes driven by formant analysis
- Live phoneme prediction and visual biofeedback
- Session history, analytics, and progress tracking
- SLP messaging and patient management
- Micro-practice exercises (3 minutes)
- PWA-installable for offline-first mobile use
- GDPR-compliant, UK-hosted

## Pricing

- Founding Member: early-access tier for individuals
- Standard: general access
- Public Funds: NHS and local authority funded
- Freemium: limited free access via partner programmes

## Technical

- Built with Next.js, React, Three.js, Supabase, Stripe
- Deployed on Vercel (EU-West region)
- WCAG 2.1 AA accessible
- GDPR and UK GDPR compliant
